requested_changes.title: Aggregate Root closure manifest rejected by single-owned-namespace verifier
requested_changes.cause: validate_cli2 applies sealed_manifest single-parent invariant to a producer-defined aggregate READS manifest. This is a metadata consumer contract mismatch, not a CLI2 runtime failure.

repair_requirements: Keep sealed_manifest and its single-namespace checks for qualification, executor and launcher manifests unchanged; add a dedicated verifier only for the exact Root aggregate schema.

Anchor aggregate MF and completion to the unchanged independent qualification evidence_refs pins; validate exact schema/actor, member ref shape, canonical bounded paths, no reparse traversal, no self member, no duplicates or conflicting pins, and all member bytes/SHA.

Verify the completion-pinned closure request and its request schema. Bind run_uuid and source_commit to the qualified current58 run; bind scope/grant/caller/E/L/tool/action/result refs using canonical path plus exact hash/bytes. Require request new_closure_output_root to equal completion/MF parent.

Reconstruct the producer READS union from closure request ref; its 10 direct refs; exactly its sealed additional refs; E/L manifest members (retaining their own namespace rules); caller stdout/stderr refs; grant scope/canonical copies; producer ref and completion ref. Require exact canonical path->SHA/bytes map equality, no unreferenced extra members or missing members. For this pinned cohort the result is 169 with 19 additional refs.

Bind caller input/output roots and scope execution roots to this same run. Treat additional refs as immutable opaque pinned inputs only after the closure request is anchored; do not recursively trust arbitrary JSON refs or use directory-only allowlists.

Preserve Root terminal observation semantics: live canonical not observed, caller OS lifecycle false, independent qualification PENDING/false flags are not rewritten. Runtime qualification remains the independently sealed Q result; no new execution/source/formal authorization.
Use a new versioned adapter and only necessary dependent pins under a new input scope; preserve failed prepare, original READY, old MF/Q and all original failure exits. Do not rerun CLI2.

limitations: Read-only diagnostic; candidate module not imported or executed.
169 aggregate member bytes rehashed; no 24000-resource backing tree rehash.
Original successful CLI2 evidence reused; no runtime repetition.
